title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. translated_title: 因果思维链：通过上下文隔离缓解注意力泄露
translated_abstract: 思维链提示能够引导模型生成逐步的推理过程，这些推理过程看似可以解释模型的预测，但无法保证这些步骤在因果上真正驱动了最终答案。在标准的自回归生成中，密集的注意力机制允许每个推理步骤关注完整的上下文，这使得模型能够通过直接查找上下文来推导答案，同时生成看似合理但实为事后辩护的解释。我们提出了CausalCoT，这是一个强制实现因果透明性的推理框架，它将问题分解为原子子问题构成的有向无环图，并在仅包含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中评估每个节点。这种马尔可夫结构移除了指向非父节点内容的注意力路径，使得下游预测对局部推理敏感，而非依赖全局上下文泄露。在多样化的推理基准测试中，CausalCoT在保持有竞争力的预测性能的同时，提升了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CausalCoT推理框架，将问题分解为原子子问题的有向无环图，并在仅含直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中评估每个节点，从而消除注意力泄露，确保思维链推理步骤对最终答案具有真实的因果驱动作用。
en_tdlr: CausalCoT is an inference framework that decomposes problems into a DAG of atomic sub-questions evaluated in isolated contexts containing only their direct causal parents, eliminating attention leakage to ensure chain-of-thought steps causally drive final answers rather than serving as post-hoc justifications.
